QuestInfo.name: [Sia Astelle] Potion for Your Pains
QuestInfo.0: While searching for Antares, you nearly fell off a cliff! Fortunately, #p9402183# saved you in the nick of time, even if you were a little beat up in the process...
QuestInfo.1: #p9402183# brought a potion. You should use it to treat your injuries.
QuestInfo.2: You tended to your injuries with the potion #p9402183# brought you.

defaultEx.0: Why haven't you used the potion I gave you yet, Sia? ...Don't tell me you've been hit by a mortal child's wish to disappear all broccoli again. The potion tastes fine! Really!
